name: Outrider
summary: Outrider; Your speed increases by 5 ft. When you Dash, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.  Outrider; When you move at least 15 ft, your next attack this turn deals +1d6 damage.  Outrider; Once per short rest, take the Dash or Disengage action as a free action on your turn.  Outrider; After you use Outrider’s Escape, your next attack before your next turn has advantage.
descriptionMarkdown:
Outrider; Your speed increases by 5 ft. When you Dash, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage.

Outrider; When you move at least 15 ft, your next attack this turn deals +1d6 damage.

Outrider; Once per short rest, take the Dash or Disengage action as a free action on your turn.

Outrider; After you use Outrider’s Escape, your next attack before your next turn has advantage.
